parameters.query:
SELECT 
  property_id,
  property_name,
  airbnb_calendar_url,
  vrbo_calendar_url,
  booking_com_calendar_url,
  google_calendar_id,
  ical_export_url,
  last_sync_at,
  owner_contact,
  preferred_platform
FROM property_configurations
WHERE property_status = 'active'
  AND (airbnb_calendar_url IS NOT NULL 
       OR vrbo_calendar_url IS NOT NULL 
       OR booking_com_calendar_url IS NOT NULL)

INSERT INTO bookings (
  booking_id, property_id, external_platform, external_booking_id,
  guest_name, check_in_date, check_out_date, booking_status, booking_type, notes
)
SELECT 
  'ext_' || md5(property_id || external_booking_id),
  property_id::uuid, external_platform, external_booking_id,
  guest_name, check_in_date::date, check_out_date::date, 
  booking_status, booking_type, notes
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
  property_id text, external_platform text, external_booking_id text,
  guest_name text, check_in_date text, check_out_date text,
  booking_status text, booking_type text, notes text
)
ON CONFLICT (property_id, external_platform, external_booking_id) 
DO UPDATE SET
  guest_name = EXCLUDED.guest_name,
  check_in_date = EXCLUDED.check_in_date,
  check_out_date = EXCLUDED.check_out_date,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING booking_id

UPDATE property_configurations
SET last_sync_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE property_id = $1

parameters.query:
SELECT
  r.review_id,
  r.property_id,
  r.platform,
  r.reviewer_name,
  r.rating,
  r.review_text,
  r.review_date,
  p.owner_contact,
  p.preferred_platform,
  p.property_name
FROM property_reviews r
JOIN property_configurations p ON r.property_id = p.property_id
WHERE r.review_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND r.notified_at IS NULL
ORDER BY r.rating ASC
LIMIT 20
